title: Multi-country foodborne event caused by cereulide in infant formula products — joint outbreak assessment
publisher: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control / European Food Safety Authority
methodology: Joint rapid outbreak assessment consolidating epidemiological and microbiological information reported by participating countries up to 13 February 2026.
limitations: The report describes a multi-country incident and surveillance limitations. It does not establish causation for individual illnesses or deaths; investigations were ongoing at the assessment date.
